assessment: In this article, García-Vázquez et al. report valuable findings demonstrating that G2 and S phases expressed protein 1 (GTSE1), is a previously unappreciated non-pocket substrate of the cyclin D/cyclin-dependent kinase (CDK) 4/6 axis. The authors provide convincing evidence showing that this mechanism is triggered in pathological states in which cyclin D levels are elevated (e.g., cancer). Overall, this study holds a promise to improve understanding of the mechanisms underpinning cell cycle progression including its dysregulation in neoplasia and may thus be of broad interest to researchers belonging to diverse biomedical disciplines ranging from cancer research to cell biology.
